scripts.title: I created an invincibility script in the  map
scripts.features: Make yourself immortal; there are no keys
scripts.script:
-- Inf Health Script Execution Notification
-- Maker: Maker98574

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TARGET_PLACE_ID = 107377364123237

-- ตรวจสอบ Map ID ถ้าไม่ตรงจะทำการเตะผู้เล่นทันที
if game.PlaceId ~= TARGET_PLACE_ID then
    Players.LocalPlayer:Kick("Incorrect Place ID!")
    return
end

-- ส่งการแจ้งเตือนแสดงชื่อผู้สร้าง
StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "Maker98574";
    Text = "Inf health applied...";
    Duration = 5;
})

-- รัน Loop ส่ง Event ใน Background
task.spawn(function()
    local damageEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Damage")
    
    while task.wait(0.5) do
        local args = {
            -math.huge
        }
        damageEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end
end)

print("Script executed successfully. Created by Maker98574")
